items.name: Broad-based backlog growth across all three segments, Q2 2026
items.claim: Caterpillar reported strong order rates and a growing backlog reflecting broadening momentum across all three of its primary segments, per its second-quarter earnings release.
items.source_excerpt: Strong order rates and a growing backlog reflect broadening momentum across all three of our primary segments.

notes: Q2 2026 8-K earnings release is the only stored evidence for Caterpillar. It confirms qualitative backlog growth across all three primary segments (Construction Industries, Resource Industries, Energy & Transportation, which houses the minor-NSR-relevant reciprocating genset line) but discloses no segment-level or dollar backlog figure.
